note: Biscuit Tin's tins, built by tools/build_biscuit.py from wordfreq's words (Robyn Speer, CC-BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq), pruned at build time by the LibreOffice Hunspell dictionaries and the LDNOOBW list. `pieces` in the tin's order, `biscuits` the four pieces of each whole biscuit in order, `words` every word the tin credits with the most pieces it takes, `fair` those the line counts on, `line` the points three stars ask for, `shown` accents.
